pre_registered.primary_metric: held-out Sample-II MAE for the standardized forced-random external-control peak-phase burden, evaluated on B4/B6/B8 pulses with same-run randomized event references
pre_registered.split: train on Sample I runs, calibrate scalar offsets on run 64 only, evaluate only Sample II analysis runs 58-63 and 65; all confidence intervals resample held-out runs
pre_registered.traditional_method: support-matched median atlas in stave, amplitude, peak-sample, and CFD-phase bins trained on forced-random control burdens
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest held-out MAE; ML wins only if its paired run-block bootstrap CI for method minus traditional is entirely below zero
